title: Racket Stringing Service Completion SLA Drift
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stringing:service
| where completion_hours=*
| stats avg(completion_hours) as avg_completion_hours max(completion_hours) as worst_completion_hours count as items by racket_name
| sort - avg_completion_hours
description: Compares how long different racket groups of stringing jobs take to finish once they are started.
value: Completion-time drift reveals which classes of admin work are easy, which are annoying, and which need a better checklist.
implementation: Send `completion_hours` from your workflow export or derive it from created and completed timestamps.
visualization: Table of average and worst completion hours by racket.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which kinds of stringing jobs take the longest to get over the finish line.
